# Applications — Use the Mathematics

Book Chapter 7 applies linear algebra to chemistry, economics, circuits, graphs, optimisation, least squares, graphics, codes and Fourier analysis. Our first examples use fitting, rotation and graph walks.

## Follow the chapters

1. [least squares](01-least-squares.qmd)
2. [graphics and rotations](02-graphics-and-rotations.qmd)
3. [graphs and matrices](03-graphs-and-matrices.qmd)

Start from the first one. Read the mathematical statement aloud, name every symbol, put numbers into it, and explain **why** it works.

**Textbook structure:** Ivan Savov, *No Bullshit Guide to Linear Algebra*, second edition, Applications — Use the Mathematics. The PDF supplied was a **preview**; these are original teaching chapters built around its topic map.
